Variable sets live in your vault's Variables folder.
[Choose Vault Folder](command:obsidian-artifacts.settings)
config.obsidianArtifacts.vaultPath.descr: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root directory. Must contain a .obsidian folder.
config.obsidianArtifacts.defaultEnvironm: Default environment identifier (reserved for future use).
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.snippe: Enable the Snippets directory. Auto-created on first vault selection.
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.aiagen: Enable the AI Agents Config directory. Auto-created on first vault selection.
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.comman: Enable the Commands directory (terminal context menu).
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.templa: Enable the Templates directory (Explorer context menu — Insert Template).
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.aiprom: Enable the AI Prompts directory. Auto-created on first vault selection.
config.obsidianArtifacts.features.variab: Enable the Variables directory (appears in all context menus).
config.obsidianArtifacts.mainPane.previe: How far the sidebar widens when a preview opens, counted in widen steps. This is a step count and not a width because VS Code exposes no API to set or read a view's width — the same number of narrow steps is applied when the preview ends, which restores the previous width without ever reading it. Set 0 to disable the resize.
config.obsidianArtifacts.mainPane.variab: Height of the preview's variables section as a fraction of the pane height (default 0.1667 — one sixth). Minimum 0.05, maximum 0.5. Dragging the section's resize handle updates this value.
